question: Is the pipeline placebo calibrated, and which way of reordering periods should placebo_test use by default?
candidate_order: permute first: when periods are exchangeable its p-value is exact, and it removes the most structure, so it should have the most power. block_permute next: it keeps volatility clustering inside blocks of round(n^(1/3)) periods. The stationary bootstrap last: it resamples with replacement, so placebo means vary.
selection: The first candidate, in the order above, whose size is at most size_max in every null cell. If none meets it, the candidate with the fewest failing cells, then the smallest mean size.
size: The share of tests in which none of the 19 placebos was at least as good as the real result, the p-value 0.05.

null_markets.single_asset: 1% daily volatility; variant flat (mean zero) or drift (an annualized Sharpe of 0.5).
null_markets.cross_section: 20 assets sharing a factor (pairwise correlation 0.3); variant flat (means zero) or dispersed (each asset a constant mean, annualized Sharpe drawn from a normal with standard deviation 0.5).
null_markets.why: Nothing in any null market can be predicted from the past, so every rejection is a false positive. Drift and dispersed means are what a long-only rule and a cross-sectional ranking earn without predicting anything.

trend_markets.single_asset: a slowly moving mean (AR(1), rho 0.98) with stationary standard deviation of strength times the 1% daily volatility; strengths 0.04, 0.08, 0.16
trend_markets.cross_section: each asset its own slowly moving mean (rho 0.99) on the common factor; strengths 0.02, 0.04, 0.08

pipelines.sma_grid: one asset, long or flat while a fast moving average of price is above a slow one; 11 (fast, slow) pairs
pipelines.tsmom_grid: one asset, long or short on the sign of the past return; lookbacks 5, 10, 21, 63, 126, 252
pipelines.xsmom_grid: 20 assets, long the 4 best and short the 4 worst by past return, rebalanced every 21 days; lookbacks 21, 63, 126, 252
pipelines.headline: the best annualized Sharpe in the grid, every rule scored on the same days after a 252-day warm-up

report.power: every candidate's rejection rate at every planted strength; not a bar
report.textbook: the naive one-sided t-test on the best rule and its Bonferroni correction, rejection rates at 0.05 in every cell, beside the placebo's
report.rank_uniformity: Pearson's chi-square of each null cell's 20 rank counts against uniform; cells beyond the 99th percentile of chi-square with 19 degrees of freedom are counted

pilot.what: A timing pilot of 250 tests per cell was run before this file was written, with base seed 20261006; its counts are in config/research/placebo-v1-pilot.json. The run this file governs uses base seed 20261007, so it shares no test with the pilot. The candidate order and bar above were set before the pilot.

consequence: placebo_test's default method is the selected candidate; a test fails if the shipped default differs from the evaluation's selection.
